ai.privacyTitle: How the AI assistant handles your data
ai.privacy1: Off by default. Nothing is sent to any AI service unless you turn it on here.
ai.privacy2: Each request is shown to you in full before sending, and is sent only when you press Send.
ai.privacy3: Only the text you act on is sent. Table column definitions are added only if you tick them; table data and credentials are never sent.
ai.privacy4: Passwords and connection-string secrets are removed. Literal values are replaced with ? unless you turn that off below.
ai.privacy5: Suggested SQL is never run automatically. The audit log records that a request was sent (provider, model, size), never its content.
ai.baseUrlHint: e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama. https:// is required except for localhost. Changing it removes the saved key.
ai.keyStored: A key is saved in the OS keychain. Type a new one to replace it.
ai.keyRequired: Required. Stored in the OS keychain; never shown again.
ai.keyOptional: Optional (local servers usually need none). Stored in the OS keychain.
ai.keySaved: API key saved to the keychain
ai.testHint: Sends a fixed test prompt with no data
ai.redactLiteralsHint: Replaces strings and numbers in SQL (and quoted values in errors and plans) with ? before sending.

access.passwordInMemory: The keychain refused the password, so it is kept only until you quit the app.
access.ownRequest: Your own request — someone else must approve it.
